Risk: Sub-optimal optical system designs in multi-layer optics
Problem analysis: Discrete-continuous parameter coupling in optical layer optimisation
Design rationale: Use MP-DQN to jointly optimise materials and thicknesses
Implementation mechanism: MP-DQN architecture with separate g and f networks for thickness proposal and Q-value estimation
Validation evidence: MP-DQN outperforms human and DQN baselines on three optical design tasks
Intervention: Deploy MP-DQN with exponential reward and Lagrangian regularisation for multi-layer optical system design
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.05769
